Section: Data leakage  Data leakage occurs when information that would not be available at prediction time is used when building the model. This results in overly optimistic performance estimates, for example from :ref:`cross-validation <cross_validation>`, and thus poorer performance when the model is used on actually novel data, for example during production.  A common cause is not keeping the test and train data subsets separate. Test data should never be used to make choices about the model.
